purpose: Deterministic LOC module classification for LunaRunes records using the canonical 66-rune dataset as the minimum authority.

authority.rule: A rune record can be classified from its canonical rune id/name and group. Additional metadata may enrich the result but is not required for basic module classification.

loc_mapping.role: The 66 drawable LunaRunes themselves and their canonical lexical definitions.
Relationships and positional context formed by 2, 3, 5, or 11-rune structures.
Lyrics, songs, music styles, and music metadata derived from or associated with rune symbols.
Literary text and writing works derived from or associated with rune symbols.
Image, video, reel, MV, and other multimedia works derived from or associated with rune symbols.
Reading logic, direction logic, moon-phase interaction, Grammar, and OW3gs interpretation rules.
Rune-group modules derived directly from the canonical grouping of the 66-rune dataset.
Recursive projection over classified rune data, relationships, rules, modules, time, and newly written-back system states.

rules: If a record resolves to one of rune ids 1-66, classify the rune itself as LOC1 / 符文語彙.
Use the canonical group field from runes66.json to additionally classify the rune under LOC7 / 符文語言模組.
Rune ids 1-64 map to the eight fixed groups of eight runes each.
Rune 65 玄 and rune 66 命 are special runes and map to 特殊符文 for module display.
Rune 0 德 is a governance/author anchor and is not part of the 66 drawable rune vocabulary.
Do not infer LOC3-LOC6 or LOC8 from rune membership alone; those require the record's actual content role or system relation.

design_principle.statement: For the 1-64 canonical rune matrix, eight runes form the basic grouping unit. The grouping is structural metadata of the symbolic language model, not a semantic-vector result.
design_principle.recursive_evolution: Classification output may be written back as structured metadata and reused by later Context, Algorithm, Module, Search, and Evolution passes.
